description: Free, read-only. JSONPath-lite query on JSON from a URL or an inline string (one of the two). Returns matches as JSON: one match bare, several as an array. Supports $, .key, ['key'], [0], [-1], [*], ..key and [?(@.k op v)]; no slices or jq. Errors on invalid JSON or over 5 MB (json_query_xl: paid, 25 MB).

json.description: Inline JSON text. Not with url.

query.description: Starts with $: '$.users[*].name', '$..price', '$.items[?(@.price<10)].id'. Filter ops: = != > >= < <= =~. '$' = whole document.

url.description: JSON URL, max 5 MB. Not with json.

name: json_query
title: Query JSON
